title: Eliminate Browser Storage Mocks & Enforce Real PostgreSQL EF Core Persistence
acceptance_criteria: Completely remove all localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, and in-memory Zustand/context mock persistence for domain entities (inventory, meals, macros, recipes, households, shopping list) from src/ediens-web.
Ensure src/Ediens.Api uses Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL connected to the real PostgreSQL database without any InMemory or static List<T> repositories.
Automatically apply EF Core schema migrations/creation and run DbInitializer seeding on backend startup so initial data resides physically in PostgreSQL.
Enforce a static grep check in ./scripts/verify.sh that fails with exit code 1 if localStorage/sessionStorage is used in src/ediens-web/src/features, pages, store, or api.
Verify via ./scripts/smoke-test.sh and direct psql queries against the postgres container that POST/PATCH/DELETE API calls mutate real rows in PostgreSQL and survive browser incognito/storage clears.
